earnings.title: JLL Reports Financial Results for Third-Quarter 2026
highlights: JLL's diluted earnings per share up 50% (in local currency 1 ) to a record $6.85 for the third quarter
Diluted earnings per share was $6.85, up 49% in USD and 50% in local currency (LC), and adjusted diluted earnings per share 1 was $6.76, up 50% in USD and 52% in LC.
Net income attributable to common shareholders grew 44% in USD and 45% in LC while Adjusted EBITDA increased 33% in USD and LC to $460.2 million.
Revenue was $7.3 billion, up 12% in USD and LC 1 , with Advisory 4 revenues up 22% in LC and Resilient 4 revenues up 9% in LC

items.heading: Operational risk relates to risks arising from systems, processes, people and external events that affect the operation of our businesses. It includes information management and data protection and security, including cybersecurity; supply chain and business disruption; health and safety; and other risks, including human resources and reputation.
